units.source_text: 驹子扬了扬左手就走了。

en.t: Komako lifted her left hand slightly and went away.

units.source_text: 她的背影好像被黑暗的山坳吞噬了。

en.t: Her retreating figure seemed to be swallowed by the dark mountain hollow.

units.source_text: 银河向那山脉尽头伸张，再返过来从那儿迅速地向太空远处扩展开去。

en.t: The Milky Way stretched toward the end of that mountain range, then turned back and from there rapidly spread out into the far reaches of space.
The mountains grew even darker and more somber.
